text:
Our love

was born in May

with malinches in bloom


—When the malinches are in bloom

in Managua—.


Only that month

do they give flowers:

in the others

they give pods

but the malinches

will bloom again

in May


and the love

that went away

will not come back

again.

translation.title: Our Love
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps 'malinches' as the Managua flowering trees whose annual return contrasts with love's non-return.
